name: Never Forget Me
source:
In all dating sims, the game ends when you finally find love, and maybe marry, or start a life together. In Never Forget Me, the game begins where most end!

The sequel of the popular otome game "Always Remember Me", this game indeed begins where we last left Amy off: after she married one of the four love interests of the first game, Aaron, Eddy, Lawrence or Hugh.

The game can be played either in pure Visual Novel mode, or with an optional stat-raising gameplay with Normal or Hard difficulty level. The stat-raising features a "Goals System" where you need to increase other stats beside the main one associated with each love interest.

Each route will have different problems, activities, main characters and unique settings.
* Aaron: Amy is busy writing her second book, but it's proving to be more difficult than ever. Meanwhile, an unpleasant character from the first game, Abigail, makes her reappearance. She wants to live in the same building! Isn't that...suspicious?
* Eddy: Amy works in the same hospital as Eddy, but he seems to be more interested in his career than her. Talking with Nathan, a dying man at the hospital, will open Amy's eyes and force Eddy to make a choice.
* Lawrence: months after their honeymoon, Amy and Lawrence still haven't consummated their marriage. It doesn't help that Monica, Lawrence's mother, is always trying to stick her nose in their lives. Amy thinks something bad happened to Lawrence when he was younger, and that affects his relationships.
* Hugh: Amy works with Hugh, but she feels that he doesn't respect her work. It doesn't help that he is always surrounded by beautiful models. However, one day a male model, Luis, shows an interest in Amy...what is she going to do?

The game features five different endings (for each character) based on your choices, plus two optional stat-based epilogues.

[From [url=http://winterwolves.com/neverforgetme.htm]official website[/url]]
translation:
在所有约会模拟游戏中，当你最终找到爱情，也许结婚，或者一起开始生活时，游戏就结束了。在《勿忘我》中，游戏从最结束的地方开始！

流行乙女游戏“永远记住我”的续集，这款游戏确实从我们上次离开艾米的地方开始：在她嫁给了第一款游戏中的四个爱人之一，亚伦，艾迪，劳伦斯或休之后。

该游戏可以在纯视觉小说模式下玩，也可以选择普通或困难难度的统计提升游戏。统计数据提升具有“目标系统”，除了与每个爱情兴趣相关的主要统计数据之外，你还需要增加其他统计数据。

每条路线都会有不同的问题、活动、主角和独特的设置。
* 亚伦：艾米正忙着写她的第二本书，但事实证明这比以往任何时候都更加困难。与此同时，第一款游戏中令人不快的角色阿比盖尔再次出现。她想住在同一栋楼里！这不是……很可疑吗？
* 艾迪：艾米和艾迪在同一家医院工作，但他似乎比她对自己的职业更感兴趣。与医院里垂死的内森交谈，艾米会睁开眼睛，迫使艾迪做出选择。
*劳伦斯：蜜月几个月后，艾米和劳伦斯仍然没有圆房。劳伦斯的母亲莫妮卡总是试图插手他们的生活，这无济于事。艾米认为劳伦斯年轻时发生了一些不好的事情，这影响了他的人际关系。
* 休：艾米和休一起工作，但她觉得他不尊重她的工作。他总是被美丽的模特包围，这也无济于事。然而有一天，一位男模特路易斯对艾米表现出了兴趣……她要做什么？

根据你的选择，游戏有五个不同的结局（每个角色），以及两个可选的基于统计的尾声。

[摘自[url=http://winterwolves.com/neverforgetme.htm]官网[/url]]
